headline: Lumax Auto Technologies completes acquisition of remaining 15.97% equity stake in Lumax FAE Technologies
sum: Lumax Auto Technologies has completed its acquisition of the remaining 15.97% equity stake in Lumax FAE Technologies Private Limited, moving to full ownership. The transaction was announced to the NSE on 29 June 2026 via formal exchange intimation.
detail: Lumax Auto Technologies Limited, a publicly listed auto-components manufacturer, has finalised its acquisition of the outstanding 15.97% equity shareholding in its subsidiary, Lumax FAE Technologies Private Limited. The transaction was formally communicated to the National Stock Exchange via a regulatory intimation filed on 29 June 2026. Lumax FAE Technologies is a joint-venture-origin entity (FAE = Five Axis Engineering heritage), and this squeeze-out brings Lumax Auto to 100% ownership. The consideration amount and detailed terms were not disclosed in the NSE filing; this may be filed separately under related-party transaction (RPT) disclosures if applicable.
